Name: Clubhouse
Description: This is the tutorial base. It is a real base with real buildings - it just has its own save, so nothing you do here reaches your own game.
Notes: No Action means clicking it only prints the Description. Good for a sign.

Name: Training Pitch
Description: A match against nobody in particular. Pick a team, then play it exactly as you would a league game.
Notes: goto:teams opens Choose Your Team. Every word ScenePaths.for_name understands works here

Name: What you can earn
Description: Everything the game can unlock and exactly what is still missing. Worth a look before your first season.

Name: The Bounty Board
Description: Adventure runs. Pick a biome and a boss, take nine players out and bring materials back.

Name: Team Shelf
Description: Where a side is built. You pick a class once, choose one card of every power in every tier, name it and give it a badge.
